mapper.select: SELECT id FROM daily_action_item WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND conversion_status_code = '01' AND target_date = CURDATE() AND is_completed = 0 ORDER BY priority_score DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cs.id AS scriptId, cs.action_item_id AS actionItemId, cs.customer_id AS customerId, cs.conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, dai.trigger_type_code AS triggerTypeCode, cc.code_name AS triggerName, cs.script_content AS scriptContent, cs.created_at AS createdAt FROM customer_script cs LEFT JOIN daily_action_item dai ON dai.id = cs.action_item_id LEFT JOIN common_code cc ON cc.group_code = 'TRIGGER_TYPE' AND cc.code_value = dai.trigger_type_code WHERE cs.action_item_id = #{actionItemId} ORDER BY cs.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT dai.id AS actionItemId, dai.customer_id AS customerId, dai.conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, dai.trigger_type_code AS triggerTypeCode, cc.code_name AS triggerName, pc.name AS childName, pc.birth_date AS childBirthDate, pc.gender AS childGender, ic.name AS parentName, ic.birth_date AS parentBirthDate, ic.gender AS parentGender FROM daily_action_item dai JOIN potential_customer pc ON pc.id = dai.customer_id AND dai.conversion_status_code = '01' JOIN integrated_customer ic ON ic.integrated_customer_id = pc.parent_customer_id JOIN common_code cc ON cc.group_code = 'TRIGGER_TYPE' AND cc.code_value = dai.trigger_type_code WHERE dai.id = #{actionItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_script ( customer_id, conversion_status_code, action_item_id, script_content ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{conversionStatusCode}, #{actionItemId}, #{scriptContent} )
